thread:
dara: Follow-up from the PM: we need an explicit, small set of owners and ETAs for rollout guardrails (auto-rollback, caps, quarantine, flapping detection). Reply +1 on what you own and add ETA.
mike: I'll take auto-rollback spec and minimal implementation hooks. Will sketch config + PR by Fri. Question: do we default to relative thresholds for perf and absolute for 5xx?
yasmin: I'll handle blast-radius caps + update the flag PR template. ETA Tue. Will add owner contact, risk_level, and rollback_SLA fields.
dara: Important: default exposure should be 0% (teams must opt-in), and critical endpoints require SRE sign-off before >2% exposure. Also add a quarantine window after rollback to avoid rapid re-rollouts.
mike: proto config (discussion):
```
feature_flag:
  key: payments_v2
  risk: high
  default_exposure_pct: 0
  rollout_stages:
    - pct: 0.5
      min_rps: 50
    - pct: 5
      min_rps: 300
    - pct: 20
  monitors:
    errors_5xx: {abs_threshold: 0.005}
    p99_ms: {rel_threshold: 0.25}
  auto_rollback:
    enabled: true
    mode: hybrid
    rel_window_sec: 300
    cooldown_min: 15
    quarantine_min: 30
    flapping_limit: 2
```
yasmin: PR checklist additions (short): flag_owner, risk_level, rollout_stages + min_rps, observables, rollback_SLA, kill_switch_cmd, oncall_contact, postrollback_playbook. I'll embed a kill-switch example in the template.
mike: Telemetry: expose rollout_state metric (pct_exposed, error_delta, last_rollback_ts, consecutive_rollbacks). Add an alert that fires when (pct_exposed >= 10 OR consecutive_rollbacks >= 2) AND error_delta > threshold.
dara: For experiments: run 0.5% canary with synthetic cache-eviction x5 and ramp QPS; if p99 > 2x or error_rate > 0.02 => rollback. Mike/Yasmin pair on CI bench.
yasmin: Also propose a baseline stability gate: do not advance if baseline_rps variance > 30% in the baseline window. That avoids advancing during unstable traffic.
sre-bot: Created INF-11010: "rollout guardrails: spec + telemetry" and pinged @mike @yasmin.
infra-bot: Logged task RG-221: add rollout_state metric instrumentation. Assigning to @mike.
dara: Ownership quick table:
- Auto-rollback spec + hooks: Mike (PR Fri) / Dara review
- Blast-radius caps + PR template: Yasmin (draft Tue) / Mike review
- Micro-canary bench + eviction repro: Mike + Yasmin (bench Mon)
- Dashboard + alerts: Mike (alert wiring by Wed) / SRE review
dara: Rollback SLA proposals: critical = 3m target to rollback; non-critical = 15m. Add to PR template.
yasmin: I'll add a small "flag maturity" page in docs: how to classify risk and the default caps per risk-level. ETA Fri for a stub.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Rollout guardrails handoff" Mon 10:00-10:20 PT with @dara @mike @yasmin.
dara: Thanks everyone. Please update INF-11010 with ETA and link to the postmortem doc. I'll follow up in the remediation sync next week. :thumbsup:
